FishHist 1.0
  • Reference

Management History data through 2026.

Source: R/data-fishhist.R
fishhist.Rd

A processed and cleaned management history dataframe.

Usage

fishhist

Format

A data frame with 45 variables:

CLUSTER_ID

Indicates the cluster ID number to which the regulation relates. A cluster is a group of like MANAGEMENT_TYPEs for like species/species groupings within the same FMP, JURISDICTION, JURISDICTIONAL_WATERS, REGION, SECTOR_CLEAN, and SUBSECTOR_CLEAN that overwrite one another (i.e., BAG LIMIT for Red Snapper in the Gulf of America). Regulations within the same cluster will have the same cluster ID number.

REG_ID

Unique identifier for each regulation entered into the database. Two rows can have the same REGULATION_ID if the regulation is recurring or if the regulation applies to multiple species/regions/zones/sectors/subsectors.

FR_CITATION

Federal Regulation Citation Number including the volume and page number (e.g., 49 FR 34590 was published in volume 49 and begins on page 34590) for regulations published in an FR Notice. Occasionally, the first page of an FR notice is blank. In those cases, the FR Citation was recorded using the page number of the page where text related to the FR Notice began.

FR_SECTION

Part, chapter, and section in which the regulation is contained (e.g., 50 CFR 622.39 is in Part 50, Chapter 622, section 39) within an FR Notice. If the “general” chapter is listed without section information (e.g. 50 CFR 622 instead of 50 CFR 622.39), the regulation was not codified (e.g., temporary regulations) or relates to an IGNORABLE MANAGEMENT_TYPE.

FR_URL

Link to the volume containing the FR notice.

FMP

Fishery Management Plan to which the regulation applies.

ACTION

Indicates the Action listed at the top of the associated FR notice.

ACTIONTYPE

Indicates the Action Type listed at the top of the associated FR notice under “Action” and after the semicolon. Loosely defined and can be left null.

AMENDMENTNUMBER

Specifies the Amendment number if “Amendment” is listed for the ACTION within the FR notice.

ACCOUNTABILITYMEASURE

A YES/NO field to indicate whether an ACL allocation was or is projected to be reached. If the resulting management measures contained in the FR Notice are intended to mitigate an overage, this field will show “YES”. This field is recorded at the FR level so all associated regulations will show "YES”.

MANAGEMENTCATEGORY

General grouping that contains more specific and related management measures (MANAGEMENT_TYPE). For example, the MANAGEMENT_CATEGORY of CATCH_LIMITS contains MANAGEMENT_TYPEs that implement catch allocations (QUOTA, ACL, ACT, etc.).

MANAGEMENT_TYPECLEAN

Specific management measure implemented, adjusted to account for “ADJUSTMENT” MANAGEMENT_TYPEs. Removes the word “ADJUSTMENT” from the MANAGEMENT_TYPE so similar MANAGEMENT_TYPEs can be grouped within the same CLUSTER to appropriately convey the history of the regulation type (i.e., BAG LIMIT and BAG LIMIT ADJUSTMENT are now in the same CLUSTER with the “ADJUSTMENT” appearing as a flag in a separate field). Renames the MANAGEMENT_TYPE of “REOPENING” to “CLOSURE” since these MANAGEMENT_TYPEs should be in the same CLUSTER to be processed together. If a regulation was a “REOPENING” the VALUE = “OPEN”. Otherwise, the MANAGEMENT_TYPE was retained.

MANAGEMENT_STATUSCLEAN

Frequency of occurrence for the regulation, adjusted to remove null values. A null management status is interpreted as “until changed.” Since end dates are filled in during processing, null management types are treated the same as management status “ONCE”. Therefore, when MANAGEMENT_STATUS is null, then MANAGEMENT_STATUS_CLEAN = “ONCE”. Otherwise, the MANAGEMENT_STATUS was retained. Includes DAILY, DELAYED, MONTHLY RECURRING, ONCE, SEASONAL, WEEKLY RECURRING, and WITHDRAWN.

JURISDICTION

Federal or State authority over the regulation.

SECTOR_CLEAN

Indicates the individual sector for which the regulation relates (Commercial or Recreational) after the expansion of the SECTOR field. If a regulation was initially entered as “ALL” for the SECTOR field during data entry, the processing expansion created two records with “COMMERCIAL” and “RECREATIONAL” under SECTOR_CLEAN.

SUBSECTOR_CLEAN

Fleet or fishing gear used in the Commercial or Recreational fisheries to which the regulation applies, expanded to indicate the specific subsector that the regulation relates to (i.e., a regulation entered as SECTOR: RECREATIONAL SUBSECTOR: ALL would be expanded into 2 records with one indicates as SECTOR_CLEAN: RECREATIONAL SUBSECTOR_CLEAN: PRIVATE and the other as SECTOR_CLEAN: RECREATIONAL SUBSECTOR_CLEAN: FOR-HIRE).

REGION

The area managed by the FMP and thus to which the regulation applies: Caribbean, Gulf of America, North Atlantic, Mid Atlantic, or South Atlantic.

ZONE_CLEAN

The specific area to which the regulation applies. The name of the ZONE matches the codified text, shapefile, or both. Coordinates are listed if applicable. If “ALL” is listed, the regulation applies to all zones/subzones in the selection REGION. Some regulations apply to a smaller spatial portion of the ZONE, unofficially referred to as a subzone in the database. A subzone is indicated by a “—” after the ZONE. Values within the ZONE field were standardized to remove abbreviations and consolidate duplicate ZONEs.

JURISDICTIONALWATERS

Federal (EEZ) or state waters in which the regulation applies.

COMMON_NAME_CLEAN

Indicates the common name for the individual species that the regulation relates to. During data entry, species information was entered using one of three fields (i.e., COMMON_NAME, SPECIES_AGGREGATE, or SPECIES_GROUP) to indicate how the regulation was implemented within the FR notice (for a single species or a group of species). During data processing, any regulations that applied to multiple species (i.e., SPECIES_AGGREGATE, SPECIES_GROUP, or COMMON_NAME == “ALL”) were expanded to create a row for each species within the indicated grouping. The previous three species fields were reformatted into the COMMON_NAME_CLEAN field to indicate the applicable individual species.

SPECIES_ITIS_CLEAN

Indicates the ITIS code for the individual species that the regulation relates to.

SPP_TYPE

Translated from the original species fields of COMMON_NAME, SPECIES_AGGREGATE, or SPECIES_GROUP to indicate how the species information was originally captured during data entry. Indicates the species category to which the SPECIES_NAME field relates.

SPP_NAME

Common name or species aggregate name. This allows you to trace back to whether the regulation was for an individual species or species within a grouping.

ADJUSTMENT

Flag to indicate whether the MANAGEMENT_TYPE for the regulation is an “ADJUSTMENT”. An “ADJUSTMENT” MANAGEMENT_TYPE indicates that a regulation is temporarily overwritten for a period of time, after which the previous regulation will continue to be in place. During data processing, “ADJUSTMENTs” that happen and then revert to prior regulations and re-openings that happen until a closure is re-implemented are treated the same and are flagged as an “ADJUSTMENT”. A value of 1 indicates that the MANAGEMENT_TYPE is an ADJUSTMENT, while 0 will indicate that it is not.

REVERSION

TRUE/FALSE field to indicate whether the record is a copy of a record that occurred before a given ADJUSTMENT record. Reversions are copies of records that occurred prior to an ADJUSTMENT and are reinstated following the end of the ADJUSTMENT period. A value of TRUE indicates that the record is a REVERSION.

EFFECTIVE_DATE

Date the regulation went into effect as stated in the Dates section of the FR Notice (MM/DD/YYYY). When the EFFECTIVE_DATE is equal to the INEFFECTIVE_DATE, the regulation has been removed (turned off).

INEFFECTIVE_DATE

Date the regulation was no longer in effect as stated in the Dates section of the FR Notice (MM/DD/YYYY). When the EFFECTIVE_DATE is equal to the INEFFECTIVE_DATE, the regulation has been removed (turned off).

STARTDATE_CLEAN

Adjusted START_DATE based on the circumstances of how the regulation changed throughout time. This field was adjusted based on the START_TIME of the regulation (i.e., if START_TIME == 11:59:00 PM the START_DAY was increased by one day to indicate that the next day is when the regulation went into effect) or the dates that species were removed from the FMP, SPECIES_AGGREGATE, or SPECIES_GROUP.

END_DATE

Adjusted END_DATE based on the circumstances of how the regulation changed throughout time (i.e., the dates that species were removed from the FMP, SPECIES_AGGREGATE, or SPECIES_GROUP; the date a regulation was overwritten by a subsequent regulation; the date the regulation was ineffective).

STARTMONTH

First month the regulation was in effect. If no START_DAY is listed, the regulation began at the start of the month.

STARTDAY_CLEAN

First day the regulation was in effect, adjusted for START_TIME. When the START_TIME = “11:59:00 PM” then a day was added to the START_DAY. Note that START_DAY_CLEAN may differ from the START_DATE (e.g., a seasonal regulation that was effective beginning on February 1, 2010 but only applied from June 1 through September 30 each year). If no START_TIME is listed, the regulation began at the start of the day.

STARTYEAR

The first year the regulation was in effect.

STARTTIME_CLEAN

Time the regulation began, in local time, adjusted to reflect START_DAY. When the START_TIME = “11:59:00 PM” it was removed and the START_DAY was increased by one day. Since we already adjusted the START_DATE_CLEAN, START_DAY, or START_DAY_OF_WEEK to reflect a START_TIME of “11:59:00 PM” we removed the value to avoid confusion. Otherwise, the START_TIME was retained. If the dates section of an FR notice recorded the start time as 2400 hours, the START_TIME field remained null because it is understood that the regulation began at the start of the day listed as the START_DAY.

START_DAYOF_WEEK_CLEAN

First day the regulation was in effect, adjusted for START_TIME. When START_DAY_OF_WEEK is populated and START_TIME = “11:59:00 PM”, a day was added to the START_DAY_OF_WEEK to correctly reflect the effectiveness of the regulation. If no START_TIME is listed, the regulation began at the start of the weekday. Used for DAILY or WEEKLY RECURRING MANAGEMENT_STATUS_CLEAN.

ENDDAY_CLEAN

Last day the regulation was in effect, adjusted to consider END_TIME. When END_TIME = "12:01:00 AM", the END_DAY_CLEAN is adjusted to be the day before the END_DAY listed. For regulations that were in effect “through the end of February”, the END_MONTH, END_DAY, and END_TIME fields were recorded as March 1 at 12:01:00 AM. The END_DAY_CLEAN is then adjusted to February 28 or 29 accordingly. If no END_TIME is listed, the regulation lasted through the end of the day.

END_DAYOF_WEEK_CLEAN

Last day the regulation was in effect, adjusted to consider END_TIME. When END_DAY_OF_WEEK is populated and END_TIME = "12:01:00 AM" then one day of the week was subtracted to adjust for the proper duration of the regulation. If no END_TIME is listed, the regulation lasted through the end of the weekday. Used for regulations that include a weekday component.

ENDMONTH_CLEAN

Last month the regulation was in effect, adjusted to consider END_TIME. When END_TIME = "12:01:00 AM" and the END_DAY was the first day of a month, the END_MONTH was subtracted by one month to adjust for the proper duration of the regulation. For regulations that were in effect “through the end of February”, the END_MONTH, END_DAY, and END_TIME fields were recorded as March 1 at 12:01:00 AM. The END_MONTH_CLEAN was then adjusted to February. If no END_DAY is listed, the regulation lasted through the end of the month.

ENDTIME_CLEAN

Time the regulation ended, in local time, adjusted for END_DAY and STATUS_TYPE. When END_TIME was listed as “12:01:00 AM” and STATUS_TYPE = “RECURRING” and the END_DAY = 1 the END_TIME of “12:01:00 AM” was retained. Otherwise, END_TIME = "12:01:00 AM" or “11:59:00 PM” was removed. For recurring regulations, the END_TIME still needs to be considered and therefore is retained.

ENDYEAR_CLEAN

The last year the regulation was in effect, adjusted depending on the END_MONTH, END_DAY, and END_TIME.

NEVERIMPLEMENTED

Flag to indicate a regulation that was recorded in an FR notice but never went into effect due to a subsequent regulation being implemented and therefore overwriting the previous regulation before it was able to go into effect. A value of 1 indicates that the regulation was never implemented while a value of 0 indicates that the regulation was implemented.

REGREMOVED

If the EFFECTIVE_DATE and INEFFECTIVE_DATE are the same, this means a regulation was removed and is no longer in effect. A value of 1 indicates that the regulation was removed while a value of 0 indicates that the regulation was not removed.

VALUE

Quantity or equation associated with the regulation. For the MANAGEMENT_TYPE_CLEAN of DEFINITION, the VALUE field reflects the term being defined. For the MANAGEMENT_TYPE_CLEAN of CLOSURE, the VALUE field indicates the status of the fishery (i.e., OPEN or CLOSE).

VALUEUNITS

Unit of measure on the VALUE.

VALUETYPE

Qualifier on the VALUE (e.g., total weight, gutted weight, etc.).

VALUERATE

Frequency on the VALUE.

FLAG

A YES/NO field to indicate if a regulation has extra details that were not able to be entered into the database due to constraints associated with the available fields.
